description: This Java source file defines a fragment class (SwipeRefreshListFragmentFragment) that extends SwipeRefreshListFragment. It demonstrates how to integrate the SwipeRefreshLayout component within a ListFragment to provide swipe-to-refresh functionality, including handling menu options to change color schemes and simulate data refresh using AsyncTask.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshListFragmentFragment
classes.description: A subclass of SwipeRefreshListFragment that implements refresh logic, menu handling for color schemes, and simulates data loading with AsyncTask.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ListView adapter with dummy data, and registers a swipe refresh listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from a menu resource.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user selections on menu items, including refresh trigger and changing color schemes.

methods.name: initiateRefresh
methods.description: Starts background task to simulate data refresh.

methods.name: onRefreshComplete
methods.description: Updates ListView data with new items and stops the refresh animation.

methods.name: DummyBackgroundTask
methods.description: An AsyncTask subclass that waits three seconds before generating a new list of dummy data.
